maya (People Ops): Quick live thread from today's all-hands about hybrid/office ops — I'll answer rapid-fire and drop links.

jordan (Eng): What's the lodging cap for week-long satellite stays?

maya (People Ops): Standard cap $250/night; high-cost cities (SF/NY/LON) $325/night. Receipts required. Link: https://handbook.redwood.com/ops/travel.

sasha (Eng-Infra): How do we reserve a team space for recurring visits?

carlos (People Ops): Submit a Team Space Request form (pinned). For recurring weeks we'll try to allocate a pod; ad-hoc days use hot-desk booking.

jordan (Eng): Family travel / childcare during offsites?

rebecca (People Ops): Family travel is not standard. Childcare reimbursement up to $150/day for overnight company offsites with manager sign-off. Exceptions via form.

ana (Finance): Expense reminder: submit within 14 days via Expensify and include cost code (default ops:satellite:travel).

sasha (Eng-Infra): Transporting hardware between offices?

carlos (People Ops): Anything >$2k needs IT + legal sign-off and signed transport form. Small peripherals are fine.

jordan (Eng): Timeline for visa letters for company-sponsored travel?

maya (People Ops): Start 6-8 weeks out; we'll provide invitation letters. Attach passport scan and dates in request.

offsite-bot: Poll  "Best offsite months" Apr / May / Sep  results in 24h.

maya (People Ops): Thanks — I'll consolidate this into a short FAQ and pin it. DM us for exceptions. :wave:
